suppress.notes: CVE-2025-7962 describes SMTP injection in Jakarta Mail/Angus Mail. DigiBank contains org.eclipse.angus:angus-activation only; it does not contain the affected mail transport implementation. Dependency- Check matched the activation artifact through a broad Angus CPE.

CVE-2025-15104 affects the Nu Html Checker (validator.nu), not org.hibernate.validator:hibernate-validator. The report matched the generic validator CPE, but DigiBank does not package Nu Html Checker or expose its validation service.
